clips.title: The story
paras: A Skin of Sweet Rum is a specialized liquor sourced from the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. It is sought after by Barkeep Daniels in Lakeshire, who is desperate to keep his tavern stocked while Blackrock orcs cut off Redridge from regular trade routes.

In the war-weary town of Lakeshire, tavern supplies are running dangerously low. The Blackrock orc invasion has choked the supply roads leading into the Redridge Mountains, leaving Barkeep Daniels scrambling to quench the thirst of beleaguered town guards and refugees. To restock his depleted shelves, Daniels sends travelers across the kingdom to gather regional specialties, including a waterskin filled with the distinctive sweet rum brewed and served in Goldshire's Lion's Pride Inn.
